why: Names QRX.pack already uses for scene actors and models; a species may not take one as its id or its creature's name. Sunny, Indigo, Biscuit and Clover were here until 2026-11-23, when the four creature glyphs became species (orange-reef-fish, blue-reef-fish, green-spotted-lizard, amber-eyespot) and their names went with them.
